sql.if: and (i.oa_id like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.oa_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.wx_id like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.wx_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.parent_id like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.parent_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or i.message like '%' + #{keyword} + '%' or c.corp_name like '%' + #{keyword} + '%')

mapper.sql: from ${syncLogItemTable} i left join ${syncLogTable} l on l.id = i.log_id left join ${cfgTable} c on c.id = i.cfgid
mapper.select:
select top (#{limit}) i.id as id, i.log_id as logId, coalesce(i.requestid, l.requestid) as requestId, i.cfgid as cfgId, c.type as platformType, c.corp_name as corpName, i.direction as direction, i.item_type as itemType, i.op as op, i.oa_id as oaId, i.oa_name as oaName, i.wx_id as wxId, i.wx_name as wxName, i.parent_id as parentId, i.parent_name as parentName, i.seq as seq, i.message as message, l.starttime as startTime, l.endtime as endTime, i.modedatacreatedate as createDate, i.modedatacreatetime as createTimeValue
order by i.id desc

select count(1) as totalCount, sum(case when i.item_type in (0, 2) then 1 else 0 end) as deptCount, sum(case when i.item_type = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as userCount, sum(case when i.op = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as createCount, sum(case when i.op = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as updateCount, sum(case when i.op = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as skipCount, sum(case when i.op = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as failCount
